offerings.title: Your Roadmap to Sustainability and Scale
offerings.body:
Sure, you want to do a capital campaign. You want to grow. But you also want your organization to last. You need to build a fundraising and revenue program that is sustainable.

I don't chase quick wins. My “secret sauce” is building systems and relationships for the long haul.

offerings.title: Coaching Fundraisers to Reach New Heights + Building a Culture of Philanthropy
offerings.body:
I'm not an athlete. I only got a varsity letter in bowling. But it turns out that former community organizers make great coaches, too. My favorite part of leading a major gifts team, and of leading a team of organizers, is coaching fundraisers.

Every frontline fundraiser needs a mentor outside their organization: someone to challenge them, provide a fresh perspective, and help them [Kate to finish this sentence].
